items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He sent some tapes over, some numbers that his band had recorded

ctx.x: But then you had another admirer from Sweden, Gusta(?) Hegler(?), who was involved with a Swedish band called Kostbandet(?). And he asked you to do some recording.
Yeah. He sent some tapes over, some numbers that his band had recorded, and they had some open spaces, I think, and he wanted me to play my solos.
Well, they also did your tune.
